Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on a method development (GLAMS) for distinguishing sialylation linkages. While the method was validated using synthetic glycans and bovine fetuin, the primary biological comparison in the proteomics dataset involves human serum from healthy controls and patients with colon and liver cancer. The enzymatic labeling (CgtA/GalNAz) is a sample-preparation/analytical step to enable linkage identification, not a biological perturbation of the samples themselves.
